context: Vercel Next.js middleware authorization bypass: one added request header (x-middleware-subrequest) makes the framework skip middleware, where many applications place access control, and the request logs as authorized. CVSS 9.1, NOT in CISA KEV, so a catalog-driven patch queue will not raise it. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period, up from 1,242,362 in the 2026-09-21 brief and rising in each of the last four briefs (85,023 in the 2026-08-30 brief). GreyNoise observed an average of 3,551 malicious sources per full day on the bypass behavior this period, and every full day ran at least four times the 495 the 2026-08-30 brief recorded on the partial final day of its window. The behavior carried 23,498 across 30 days. Reject the header at the edge; do not scope controls by source network.

React Server Components unsafe deserialization reaching unauthenticated code execution. CVSS 10.0, in CISA KEV since 05 December 2025 with known ransomware campaign use. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period, up from 298,964 in the 2026-09-21 brief. Adjacent to the Next.js bypass in Finding 4.

Sophos Firewall user portal and web administration authentication bypass reaching code execution. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 31 March 2022. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period, more than four times the 2026-09-21 brief's 30,115 and up from 430 two windows ago. Intensifying. Re-verify firmware on every appliance, including those confirmed last week.

F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth authorization server heap overflow reaching unauthenticated code execution on the access gateway. CVSS 9.8, added to CISA KEV on 22 September 2026 with a federal deadline of 25 September. Connection attempts on the GreyNoise exposure check behavior this period, about 99% of them from 46.151.182.18 on 24 September; new to this brief series. GreyNoise observed 10 sources on the behavior this period, four of them on the final (partial) day. F5 BIG-IP Crawler rose to 106,008 from 32,233 in the prior brief's window.

Spring Cloud Function SpEL routing expression injection reaching unauthenticated code execution. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 25 August 2022. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period, up from 3,757 in the 2026-09-21 brief, where it was the lead finding. Intensifying.

Elastic Kibana console file inclusion. No published severity score, NOT in CISA KEV. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period, up from 2,099 in the 2026-09-21 brief. Intensifying alongside CVE-2022-22963.

Mesop 1.2.2 and earlier unauthenticated Python execution via the /exec-py endpoint. CVSS 9.8, NOT in CISA KEV. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period; new to this brief series. Zero sources through 24 September, then 311, 275, 384 and 247 daily from 25 to 28 September (partial day). All 789 sources classified malicious and all on AS13335 (484) and AS396982 (305), networks that also carry legitimate traffic, so a network block is not viable. Nearly all also attempted CVE-2025-29927.

CrushFTP virtual file system sandbox escape via server-side template injection, unauthenticated arbitrary file read. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 24 April 2024. Corpus-wide connection attempts this period, up from 61 in the prior brief's window. 79 sources on 27 September and no malicious source on the behavior on any other day in ten days; 52 of the 79 also attempted CVE-2024-51567.

CrushFTP authentication bypass via crafted AWS4-HMAC authorization header, takes over the built-in crushadmin account. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 07 April 2025 with known ransomware campaign use. GreyNoise tags it as the rejected duplicate CVE-2025-2825; connection attempts on that tag this period, up from 512 in the prior brief's window. 68 sources on 26 September against one to five daily on 21 to 24 September.

CyberPanel upgrademysqlstatus unauthenticated code execution. CVSS 10.0, in CISA KEV since 07 November 2024 with known ransomware campaign use. Corpus-wide connection attempts on the CyberPanel RCE Attempt tag this period. 52 sources on 27 September against zero or one on every other day; all 52 also attempted CrushFTP CVE-2024-4040 that day.

Resolve each member on its own record rather than blocking the range; key controls on the SSH Bruteforcer and ENV Crawler tags.
